verdicts.proof: Old: profile_screen.dart:73-83 initState invalidates profileProvider and loyaltyStatusProvider (also in 4.1.3, git show 70a94933 :73-74). The v2 view is returned from the same State's build (profile_screen.dart:234-237), so initState has already run. The only route to the profile in both looks is router.dart:399-401 (const ProfileScreen() through routerTabPage), and no other v2 file builds a profile view. v2 adds pull-to-refresh (profile_hub_v2.dart:120-125, :135) which calls the same onRetry = ref.invalidate(profileProvider) (profile_screen.dart:245) and is switched off while the form is open.
verdicts.fix_idea: None needed; silent in both looks by design (cache refresh).

verdicts.proof: Old: ready = !loading && error == null && _loaded (profile_screen.dart:209), progress bar at :336-340, form only if _personalExpanded && ready (:365). v2 receives the same ready flag (:243); ProfilePersonalV2 opens only when expanded && ready (profile_personal_v2.dart:87) and shows _SummarySkeleton while loading (profile_hub_v2.dart:156 passes profile null while loading; profile_personal_v2.dart:133, :314-328); header skeleton when no profile yet (profile_hub_v2.dart:141, profile_header_v2.dart:79-95). The 4.1.3 old screen was a full-screen spinner (70a94933 :178), so the menu-while-loading behaviour is a branch change shared by both looks.

Old: MgErrorView(compact, what: eoProfileLoadFail, onRetry: invalidate profileProvider) at profile_screen.dart:341-350. v2: identical widget, key and retry closure at profile_hub_v2.dart:144-148 with onRetry from profile_screen.dart:245; v2 also adds pull-to-refresh to the same retry.

Old: loyalty_rank_card.dart:17-18 returns SizedBox.shrink when loyaltyStatusProvider has no value; used at profile_screen.dart:353. v2: the rank strip with level/percent is drawn only if status != null (profile_header_v2.dart:45, :107); the avatar tap to ranks only if status != null (:59); the semantic label with percent is null when status is null (:53). rankTokensProvider falls back to neutral RankTokens.brand when status is null (core/v2/rank/rank_provider.dart:10-13), so no rank colour or discount is shown. The discount itself is computed server-side.
verdicts.fix_idea: None needed; hiding until known is intentional in both looks.

verdicts.proof: Old: MgBackArrow -> context.backOr(Routes.home) (profile_screen.dart:307). v2: MgV2Back onTap: onBack ?? backOr(Routes.home) (profile_header_v2.dart:69-73). onBack is non-null only when the profile route is not first (profile_booking_fix_v2.dart:37-41) and then does backOr(Routes.profile), which pops because a previous page exists; the pinned back (profile_hub_v2.dart:136) uses the same closure. System back uses the same routerTabPage page in both looks (router.dart:169-171, :401). Neither path leaves the app.

Old: onPersonal (profile_screen.dart:211-225) refuses to open when !ready: error snack with retry, or toast eoProfileStillLoading; form shown only if expanded && ready (:365). In 4.1.3 the toggle had no ready check (70a94933 :238-239), so this is a branch addition. v2 entry points to the form: (1) the Upravit/Zavřít button, _EditButton onTap: onToggle (profile_personal_v2.dart:101) = onTogglePersonal = onPersonal (profile_screen.dart:246, profile_hub_v2.dart:159); (2) the booking-fix auto-open (profile_hub_v2.dart:83-88), which returns early unless widget.ready and then calls the same onTogglePersonal. In both cases the form body renders only if expanded && ready (profile_personal_v2.dart:87, :115). The summary _Field 'Doplnit' values have no onTap (profile_personal_v2.dart:256-270), so they are not another entry. The message is the same toast/snack as old.
verdicts.fix_idea: None required (same toast as old). Optional: show the Upravit button dimmed while !ready so the state is visible from the button.

verdicts.proof: Old: ProfileField(readOnly: true) at profile_screen.dart:410 (also in 4.1.3, 70a94933 :288); _save never sends email (:137-150). v2: the same _emailCtrl (PfFormData email, profile_screen.dart:250) rendered with readOnly: true, a lock icon and the note v2PfEmailNote (profile_personal_form_v2.dart:75-88); summary shows a lock (profile_personal_v2.dart:197). Saving uses the same _save. Server: _trg_guard_customer_profile_columns keeps email on a direct customer write (SUPABASE_BACKEND_STATE_4.md:45). v2 is clearer than old.

Old: DateDropdownField lastYear = _dob.year if > now-18 else now-18 (profile_screen.dart:416-427); the widget widens only to the currently selected year (core/widgets/date_dropdown_field.dart:105-116). v2: the same formula at profile_screen.dart:254-257 goes through PfFormData to the same DateDropdownField (profile_personal_form_v2.dart:90-97); in v2 the widget renders DateFieldRowV2 with the same years list (date_dropdown_field.dart:193-214), and the year sheet offers only that list (features/auth/v2/date_field_v2.dart:130), with no free-text entry. No other v2 widget writes date_of_birth (grep finds no other profiles writes in v2 files). In 4.1.3 the limit was now-15 (70a94933 :298); 18 is a branch change shared by both looks. Server: the age check exists only in the door-code gate (_docs_gate_checklist / trg_release_codes_on_profile_verify, STATE_4.md:205), not on the profile write.
verdicts.fix_idea: None required for parity (silent in both looks). Optional: a one-line hint under the field 'Půjčovna od 18 let'.

verdicts.proof: Old: firstYear = now, lastYear = now+20 (profile_screen.dart:430-436), and the widget widens to a saved past year (date_dropdown_field.dart:105-106). v2: licFirstYear = saved expired year or now, licLastYear = now+20 (profile_screen.dart:259-262), passed to the same DateDropdownField (profile_personal_form_v2.dart:106-112); the widget widens the same way. Because _licExp follows the selection (onLicExp at :266), once a future year is picked the past year leaves the list in both looks. So the year list is the same. v2 can additionally show expiryNote in booking-fix mode (profile_personal_form_v2.dart:113-116).

Old: _licCategoryOptions = AM/A1/A2/A/B (profile_screen.dart:70) rendered as chips (:445-492). v2: the same list licOptions: _licCategoryOptions and the same Set (profile_screen.dart:263-273) rendered as PfLicenceChip with onTap -> onToggleCategory (profile_personal_form_v2.dart:120-123). The summary chips have no onTap (profile_personal_v2.dart:207-209). Server: set_my_license_group keeps only valid values (STATE_3.md:142).
